messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up, ClearCloud Accounting asked whether to send a W-8 or W-9. They also flagged a contract "gross-up" clause and are asking if Redwood will apply it.

Maya Patel: Excerpt from their email:
```
We are incorporated in the US as an LLC but majority-owned by a UK holding co. Please confirm which IRS form you need. Our PO/contract mentions Redwood will "gross-up" payments to cover any withholding taxes. Is that active?
```

Jules AP: Tagging @Ben (Tax) and @Legal (Contracts). AP cannot process invoice 8921 without the tax form on file.

Ben (Tax): Short answer: If they are a US resident for tax (EIN, taxed in US), we need a W-9. If they claim foreign status, W-8BEN-E + proof of foreign tax residency. Ownership by a foreign parent doesn't itself make them foreign for US tax purposes.

Samir Rao: Invoice 8921 shows ClearCloud LLC, US address, no TIN. I'm flagging payments until we get documentation.

Maya Patel: I replied asking them to upload a signed W-9 PDF and provide their EIN/TIN. Also asked them to attach the contract page that references gross-up so legal can review.

ClearCloud Accounting: Thanks Maya, we'll upload the W-9 and EIN today. For clarity: procurement told us they normally include gross-up on cross-border SOWs, but contract attached. See portal: https://billing.clearcloud.co/inv/8921

invoice-bot: Invoice 8921 status -> ON_HOLD. Reason: missing tax form (W-9/W-8).

Legal (Contracts): Received the excerpt, we'll check the exact wording. Our baseline is we do not accept automatic gross-up unless Legal & Finance approve and commercial redlines it. If the SOW explicitly requires gross-up we need a redline or amendment.

Ben (Tax): Once W-9 + EIN received we clear the vendor as US taxable entity, no withholding or gross-up expected. If they later submit W-8 claiming treaty benefits we'll reassess and may apply withholding per IRS regs (section 1441 etc.).

Jules AP: Thanks all. Action items: AP waits for W-9+EIN (Maya to confirm upload), Legal to confirm whether contract language obligates gross-up (Legal to advise), Finance (Ben) to confirm withholding if W-8 provided. Payments remain on hold until cleared.

Samir Rao: Noted, hold remains. Added AP note: "Awaiting W-9 with EIN or valid W-8 + Legal confirmation on gross-up."

Maya Patel: I'll close the loop when W-9 is in Concur/Vendor portal.

ClearCloud Accounting: W-9 uploaded (pdf attached in portal) and EIN provided: XX-XXXXXXX. Please confirm next steps so we can get paid.

Ben (Tax): Received copy via AP portal. I'll validate EIN and update tax classification. If everything checks out we'll release payment and no gross-up applies.

Jules AP: Payment release scheduled once Ben confirms. Closing thread when payment completes. :white_check_mark:
